title: Harden soft-update activation against invalid definitions and path collisions
goal: Prevent soft-update payloads from breaking live Agent/Skill discovery and reject path collisions or malformed remote trees before any workspace mutation.
context: This checkpoint hardens the already implemented read-only transport and transactional activation. It validates all affected Markdown definitions and rejects case-insensitive path collisions and duplicate Git tree paths.
forbidden_changes: Do not load or execute downloaded native code.
Do not push or mutate the remote repository from the app.
Do not overwrite local edits when base hashes differ.
Do not claim native Swift/UI/framework changes can be applied without a signed IPA.
acceptance_criteria: The repository contains a valid manifest and a real text-only Skill.md update with correct byte count and SHA-256.
The first update is based on initial state and repeat checks of the installed revision report up-to-date.
The protocol documents how to advance baseRevision, revision, base hashes, and content hashes for future releases.
Settings activates only after revalidation and a durable snapshot; rollback preserves unrelated workspace edits and blocks if updated files were changed after activation.
Before activation, all existing and updated Skill.md and Agent.md files parse successfully with unique IDs; duplicate remote tree paths and case-insensitive file path collisions fail closed.
Definition validation is exposed by PAComposition (the layer that depends on PASkills); tests cover duplicate Skill/Agent IDs.
verification: Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI results
recovery: Revert this single logical commit if package compilation, contract validation, or staging-boundary tests regress.
